data.narrative:
Slingshot Aerospace is a Series A frontier-tech company in Space & Aerospace founded by Melanie Stricklan, Thomas Ashman, and David Godwin. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is applicable. Using the company's $120M total raised as a value proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $240M. Peer-median triangulation is not feasible due to insufficient narrow peer datapoints within the same stage and valuation tier (0 same-stage comps, 2 adjacent-stage comps identified, below the 3-point threshold). Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace median P/S multiple of 27.4x cannot be applied without the target's revenue, which private companies rarely disclose.

The analysis supports a range of $204M to $276M (low to high), centered on a median of $240M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression point estimate. Primary uncertainties include the absence of revenue-based valuation methods and a sparse peer set at this stage within the sector, limiting triangulation robustness. Additional disclosure of financial metrics would sharpen the valuation.
